## Intel deepens AI data center push with co-packaged optics initiative

Co-packaged optics is a battleground technology for next-generation AI cluster interconnects; INTC entering this space more aggressively creates a credible second source dynamic and could pressure incumbent suppliers while validating the compute-topology theme.

- INTC is expanding its presence in AI data centers via co-packaged optics technology
- Co-packaged optics is a compute topology play — integrating optical interconnects closer to silicon to reduce latency and power at scale
- Signals INTC is competing on AI infrastructure architecture, not just traditional CPU market share
- Classifier confidence is high; concrete product-strategy move with implications for AI compute topology competition
